summary: Visible change: a history text Markdown would render differently shows skeleton lines instead of its raw source until react-markdown has loaded; plain text and the running turn stay raw. AiChatProvider loads react-markdown on mount; new preloadMarkdown() and markdown.preload. Server HTML unchanged.
howTo: Nothing to do. While loading, such a text's [data-component="markdown"] contains div[data-element="markdown-skeleton"][data-state="loading"][aria-busy="true"] with up to 8 span[data-element="markdown-skeleton-line"] (width estimated from the source, wrapping) and a visually hidden text (locale key markdownLoadingLabel, optional, German ships; not announced); its DOM text is that label, the source is not in the DOM, the copy button copies the source as before. It applies to text with a Markdown-significant character (backslash ` * _ [ ] < > & | ~ # : @, line break, tab, mention markers, leading whitespace or - + = 1., www.; all text with entity links on), not to the running turn (latest message while loading, latest question); plain text stays raw as before. The choice is made at the text's first render and kept until Markdown renders. Size is inline (works with unstyled and own layouts); adjust with --cm-markdown-skeleton-color, -line-height, -gap, -radius, -padding, -max-width. The pulse is off under prefers-reduced-motion. react-markdown now downloads when AiChatProvider mounts, also for a closed floating chat and headless use, unless components.Markdown or components.MessageBubble is set (an own bubble on useMessageParts still renders the default Markdown: call preloadMarkdown() yourself); markdown={{ preload: false }} turns it off. Without react-markdown installed, its console.warn appears at mount. preloadMarkdown(): same promise every call, never rejects, safe on the server; once resolved, Markdown renders without a skeleton. Server HTML is unchanged; hydration reports the same errors, but where React replaces a server-rendered message while loading, such a text shows the skeleton instead of the source. Tests that read such a [data-component="markdown"] text right after render now see the label: wait (findBy…/waitFor) or await preloadMarkdown() first.
